content.short: Reown is an advanced decentralized protocol designed for seamless wallet connection tools within the Web3 ecosystem on Ethereum.
content.description: Reown, formerly known as WalletConnect, focuses on building tools and infrastructure to improve app UX and seamless wallet connectivity in Web3. Built organically for the Web3 ecosystem, Reown provides an essential suite of services focused heavily on wallet connection tools. By operating on Ethereum, it allows users to experience fast execution times while maintaining strong cryptographic security. The protocol is designed to be highly interoperable, aiming to become a cornerstone of the Web3 Wallet Tools sector. Through continuous innovation, Reown contributes to the broader vision of a decentralized, permissionless digital economy.
content.meta: Reown provides innovative wallet connection tools tools for the Web3 Wallet Tools space. Discover Reown and other decentralized applications on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
